description: A continuous image of a compact set is compact.
naturalProof: Since s is compact and f is continuous, the image f '' s is compact by the continuous-image theorem.
naturalDraft: 因此 $IsCompact (f '' s)$，由紧集的连续像，使用 hs 和 hf
